clips.title: The story
paras: At Menethil Harbor, Captain Stoutfist directs the defense against Dragonmaw attacks. The dwarf officer coordinates the garrison’s defenses and counterstrikes to keep the Alliance port from falling.

Menethil Harbor is the principal deepwater port linking Ironforge and Stormwind to the Wetlands and the sea beyond. Captain Stoutfist commands the town’s defense, guarding its docks, people, and garrison from the dangers around them. The marshlands are hazardous, but the greatest threat is an organized advance by renegade orcs.

The Dragonmaw clan has held strongholds in the Wetlands since the Second War and now presses toward the roads and mountain passes. By infiltrating Dun Algaz, the orcs threaten the overland route linking Loch Modan and Ironforge with Menethil Harbor. Stoutfist has too few troops, so he depends on Alliance volunteers sent by Mountaineer Valstag Ironjaw to hold them back.
